transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because my eating just went completely off the rails. I usually track my food, but I just... stopped caring about it entirely. I've been skipping real meals for days, basically just living on coffee and protein bars. It got to the point where my clothes started hanging loose on me before I even really noticed what was happening.
Are you avoiding meals because you’re trying to lose weight or change your body shape?

No, it's not... I'm not trying to lose weight or anything like that. It's definitely not about my body shape. I just... I don't know, I just completely stopped thinking about food. It just hasn't been on my mind at all.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. It really hit me after a project sponsor at work questioned my judgment on something. It was like... I don't know, the bottom just dropped out completely. I just sat in my apartment feeling totally hollow and ashamed. I found myself just crying over regular work emails that I normally would have handled without a second thought. So, yeah, it's been really heavy.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yeah, I have. I just started thinking that everyone at work would be better off if I just didn't wake up. It got so bad that right after that meeting, I actually said out loud that I should just walk into traffic and be done with it.
Did all of this start after that meeting where your judgment was questioned at work?

Yeah, exactly. Ever since that meeting, it's just been this... this hollow, ashamed feeling. I completely lost interest in everything. And it's just dragged on and on. It's been about three months now of feeling like this every single day.
Over these past three months, have you felt sad or empty most of the day nearly every day?

Yeah, pretty much every day. Like I said, ever since that sponsor questioned my judgment, it's just been this constant feeling. The bottom just dropped out, and I've spent most days sitting in my apartment feeling completely hollow and ashamed. I mean, I'm literally crying over basic work emails that I used to handle without even thinking twice about it. So, yes, it's been most of the day, every day.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

No, not really. I haven't noticed any issues with my focus. I mean, I can still concentrate on things if I need to... it's just that I don't really have the drive to actually do them anymore. But my concentration itself seems fine, I guess.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, it's been pretty bad. Even when I actually try to sleep, I just... I keep waking up at these weird hours. My mind goes right back into the deployment plan, and I can't seem to shut it off. So by the time morning comes around, I just feel completely wrecked instead of actually feeling rested.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?

No, I don't think so. I haven't noticed myself moving slow or talking any slower than normal. I just feel exhausted, but I'm not moving in slow motion or anything like that. No one has said anything to me about it either.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?

Not really low on energy, no. I mean, like I just said, I feel exhausted from not getting any sleep, but my actual energy levels are... fine, I guess. I'm still up and working on the plans. I don't have that heavy feeling where you can't get out of bed or do anything. It's just the lack of sleep making my body feel wrecked.
Have you noticed that your appetite has been much lower than usual?

Yeah, actually. That's a big part of why I came in. My eating just went completely off the rails. I usually do food tracking, but I just... stopped caring about it. I was skipping real meals for days at a time, mostly just living on coffee and protein bars while I worked. I didn't even realize how bad it was until I noticed my clothes were just hanging loose on me.
When your clothes started hanging loose, were you glad about the weight loss?

No, not at all. I wasn't trying to lose weight. It wasn't a goal or anything. I just... I was so focused on the plans and everything I had to do that eating just didn't happen. Seeing how much weight I dropped actually kind of worried me, to be honest. It wasn't something I wanted to happen.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. It's actually been pretty noticeable. Normally, I'm really into hiking and editing photos... and I mentioned the meal logging earlier, but I haven't wanted to do any of that. I even have this woodworking project sitting out in my garage that I haven't touched in a while. It's strange because those are the kinds of things that usually keep me grounded, but lately, I just have zero interest in them.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge most days?
No, not really. I wouldn't say I've been anxious or on edge. It's more just... everything else I was talking about. But no, anxiety hasn't been an issue.
Do these feelings seem much stronger than you would normally expect after something like that meeting at work?

Yeah, definitely. I mean, usually if someone questions my judgment at work, I'd just brush it off or deal with it. But after that sponsor said what they did during the meeting, it was... it was like the bottom just dropped out. I came back to my apartment and just sat there. I felt completely hollow and just... really ashamed. I even found myself crying over regular work emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought. It was way out of proportion.
Even when you're not thinking about that meeting or work, do you still feel depressed?

Yeah, it doesn't really go away. Even when I'm not thinking about work at all, I just... I still feel that way. Like I said, ever since that sponsor questioned my judgment, I've just felt completely hollow. I sit in my apartment and just feel this heavy sense of shame, and it's there all the time. I'm still just... crying over nothing, like those emails. It's just a constant feeling right now.
